'''''Reson Nath v. Imperial Prefect Adar''''' was a legal case that took place during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Reson Nath]] paid the [[Adar's nephew|nephew]] of the [[Imperial Prefect]] [[Adar (Imperial)|Adar]] for some information, the young [[Gender/Legends|man]] used the money to elope with his girlfriend rather than attend [[University/Legends|university]] as Adar had planned for him, and Adar responded by accusing Nath of a crime under the law of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] chapter [[House Paramexor]]. The trial took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denevar]], with five [[Human/Legends|Humans]] presiding over the case to decide the outcome, including [[Janq Paramexor]], his [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Kaith]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Gorliz]]&mdash;a representative of the Imperial leader [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The charges were read out to Nath and after she had argued her case as to why she believed she was innocent, the judges ruled that, in accordance with Paramexor law, Nath and Adar should resolve the matter by fighting each other with [[Sword/Legends|swords]].
